sources.title: Threat Model and Attack Taxonomy | maferrag/AlphaSecBench | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a detailed breakdown of the AlphaSecBench threat model, defining the capabilities, vectors, and specific attack types used to evaluate LLM agents. The benchmark uses a structured security overlay system to inject adversarial events into UAV mission episodes, testing the agent's ability to detect, mitigate, and reason about cyber-physical threats.
